aiSummary.oneLiner: Curated collection of advanced expressions for Adobe After Effects.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides a comprehensive library of complex JavaScript expressions specifically designed for Adobe After Effects. It offers modular code snippets that automate tedious keyframing tasks, such as procedural bouncing, dynamic linking, and physics simulations. The expressions are optimized for the modern JavaScript engine within After Effects, ensuring fast render times even on complex compositions. By utilizing these scripts, motion designers can create intricate, easily adjustable animations driven by math rather than manual keyframes.
keyFeatures: Procedural animation: Generates complex motion like spring physics and sine waves without manual keyframes.
Dynamic linking: Connects multiple layer properties together for centralized, slider-based control.
Modern JavaScript: Written using modern ES6 syntax optimized for the latest After Effects expression engine.
Responsive design: Automatically scales and adjusts animation timing based on layer in and out points.
Modular snippets: Designed to be easily copied, pasted, and customized within individual layer properties.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Motion designers and video editors working heavily in Adobe After Effects. It requires a basic understanding of expressions and JavaScript syntax.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Copy the desired .jsx snippet directly into the expression field of an After Effects property.
